title: Observability: CBC sess_init wc_AesInit/wc_InitRng_ex raw error codes silently dropped
description: wolfssl_aes_cbc_sess_init: wc_AesInit() and wc_InitRng_ex() failure paths call wolfssl_cbc_xlat_err(ret) and return without logging the raw wolfCrypt error code first. A support engineer reading dmesg after a sess_init failure cannot tell whether it was wc_AesInit or wc_InitRng_ex that failed, or what wolfCrypt returned. Compare with wc_AesSetKey which does log before translating. Fix: add pr_err_ratelimited('%s: wc_AesInit returned %d', __func__, ret) and pr_err_ratelimited('%s: wc_InitRng_ex returned %d', __func__, ret) before each wolfssl_cbc_xlat_err() call on these paths.
close_reason: Added pr_err_ratelimited before wolfssl_cbc_xlat_err() in wc_AesInit and wc_InitRng_ex failure paths in wolfssl_aes_cbc_sess_init — raw wolfCrypt codes now logged before translation
